resources.string: Apply these changes? The previous profiles will remain available for undo. Values of credentials are hidden. Up to 100 changes are listed.
Restore profiles from before the last subscription update? Current profile edits in this group will be replaced. Traffic counters are preserved.
A newly added profile is in use. Before undoing, switch the VPN to another profile and remove references to this node from settings.
Uses the control sites and thresholds from global fallback settings. Local addresses stay direct. A custom JSON route can override this policy.
Select profile and DNS by network

Applies on VPN start and network changes. Specific Wi-Fi SSIDs take precedence over generic Wi-Fi. Blank DNS fields inherit global settings. Without SSID access, generic Wi-Fi is used. Full custom configurations retain their own DNS.
Invalid DNS, profile or duplicate network condition.

For automatic SSID matching while the VPN runs in the background, open Permissions → Location and select “%1$s”. The app reads only the connected Wi-Fi name, not GPS coordinates. This is optional: generic Wi-Fi/mobile profiles work without location access.
On Android 10+, SSID matching requires precise location access allowed all the time; system Location must also be enabled. Otherwise generic Wi-Fi is used, including while the app is visible.
SSID permission is available. Keep system Location enabled for SSID matching.
